B01.reason: Separate repeatable binding builds from runtime handle safety and production persistence exports.

C01.reason: Filesystem policy and authenticated read sessions have separate platform APIs and tests.

C02.reason: Core ingestion transaction and native ownership handoff are independently implementable boundaries.

J02.reason: Keep retry/dispatch policy in Rust and isolate Swift lifecycle effects.

L04.reason: Portable serialization and the native authenticated share lifecycle are distinct deliverables.

L03.reason: Eligibility/time policy belongs in the core; native file deletion has a separate retry lifecycle.

E03.reason: Sampling/budget policy and authorized remote diagnostic execution can be reviewed separately.

C04.reason: Recorder ownership/state machine and the recovery presentation are separate native surfaces.

C05.reason: Platform speech capability and durable queue integration involve different failure boundaries.

N04.reason: Capacity allocation is deterministic core logic; notification authorization is a native state source.

I03.reason: Reminder grammar and session-topic recognition are independent bounded offline interpretations.

V05.reason: Separate an independently secure transport effect from its core request adapter, without postponing transport security.

U02.reason: Search navigation and detailed source/audio presentation are separate screens.

U03.reason: Authoritative content correction and item lifecycle actions have different forms and conflict behavior.

U04.reason: Reminder editing and evidence-only history are independently reviewable UI components.

U05.reason: Non-secret provider configuration can be built separately from secure credential entry and connection checks.

U06.reason: Initial policy setup and later revocation/requeue controls are separate workflows.

U07.reason: Three unrelated data-management flows should not be one implementation ticket.

U08.reason: Prompt configuration and the suggestion response card are different UI surfaces.

T02.reason: Process-level capture durability and provider/application races need different fault harnesses.

T04.reason: Outbound processing authorization and local read/output privacy are different attack surfaces.

T12.reason: Provider/permission failures and destructive lifecycle races form two bounded UI journeys.

L05.reason: The original Swift-only scope omitted Rust-owned reset fencing. Separate the atomic core reset operation from native cleanup orchestration.

V08.reason: The worker can only produce server-side protocol evidence; phone-context reachability over Tailscale is a maintainer input. Separate them so the probe can be reviewed and landed while the device evidence stays an honest block.

P08.reason: Signing automation is Linux-testable with stubbed Apple tools; a signed device install is a maintainer input on a Mac with Xcode. Separate them so the tooling can land while the device evidence stays an honest block.

tasks.title: Make production bindings reproducible
tasks.intent: Reuse the P01 proof to establish deterministic simulator/device generation and module-local export discovery; do not add product service operations yet.
acceptance: Clean build produces matching Rust/Swift bindings for supported targets without modifying tracked files; generated files remain build output.
A minimal real-core value/error round trip builds and runs under simulator CI; document how later owned modules declare exports without concurrent central-file edits.

tasks.title: Implement safe native core handles and callbacks
tasks.intent: Implement the shared handle lifetime, error conversion, cancellation and callback-threading boundary used by production exports.
acceptance: Repeat initialization/destruction and cancellation, reject invalid handles/input, and convert normalized errors without panic/exception or invalid string ownership crossing the ABI.
Exercise background callbacks against the real core in simulator tests, delivering UI-facing effects on the documented thread and preventing callbacks after cancellation/teardown.

tasks.title: Expose durable capture and status through production bindings
tasks.intent: Connect the established bridge to existing capture persistence and status operations, with no duplicate store or new service registry.
acceptance: Swift saves and reads a real persisted capture and independent processing/scheduling statuses through core operations; failed save produces no durable-success acknowledgment.
Test restart, duplicate capture ID and normalized failure on simulator; verify the preceding lifetime and generated-binding mechanisms remain the only production path.
ownership_allowances: ios/Tests/CoreBridge/CaptureStatusTests.swift (single file; granted 2026-10-08 after PR #110; ordered after B01b, which has landed)
recorded_decisions: ohand_core_start_save_capture is a pre-import durable capture write, not the Capture Ingestion Contract acknowledgment; it accepts any non-empty route_id. C02a owns unknown-route rejection, the import transaction and the contracted acknowledgment (capture ID, item ID, save timestamp).

tasks.title: Implement secure bounded native provider transport
tasks.intent: Implement the native HTTP effect with TLS/destination checks, opaque credential lookup, redaction and limits from its first usable version.
acceptance: Controlled fixture-server tests cover timeout, cancellation, bounded responses and normalized errors; no cleartext/certificate bypass or credential forwarding across origins is possible.
Require the established authorized destination/capability contract before dispatch and keep secrets inside the native operation; unapproved requests produce no network effect.

tasks.title: Connect core provider requests to native transport
tasks.intent: Map the existing provider transport/effect interface through production bindings to the secure native implementation.
acceptance: Real-core simulator tests exercise valid requests, denied/revoked routes and cancellation through the complete boundary; response/error mapping preserves the existing provider contract.
Version/credential references resolve at dispatch, redirects and error diagnostics remain protected, and no protocol adapter acquires raw secrets.
ownership_allowances: core/src/ffi/provider_transport.rs (+ tests) and its pub mod line in core/src/ffi/mod.rs
ios/project.yml: OhAndServices target core search-path/link settings and OhAndCoreBridge dependency (one-time)
ios/Tests/ProviderTransport/: SQL seeding helper for real-core tests (fixture only)

tasks.title: Recognize supported offline reminder commands
tasks.intent: Recognize only the documented explicit reminder grammar using the existing date resolver and sourced proposal contract.
acceptance: Minimal pairs cover negation, quotation, hypothetical/reported speech, completed work, absent times and unsupported recurrence; ambiguous input abstains.
Supported commands produce sourced proposals offline; unmatched language remains available to the approved interpreter and never disappears or silently schedules.

tasks.title: Recognize explicit offline session-topic phrases
tasks.intent: Add the bounded local session-topic grammar and compose its result with the existing reminder recognizer.
acceptance: Explicit session phrases produce only the derived topic facet; negative/quoted/ambiguous phrases abstain and neither scope nor disclosure permissions can change.
Test provider-free session-note retrieval handoff and mixed reminder/topic input while preserving source; the reminder recognizer remains behaviorally unchanged.

tasks.title: Apply native file protection and backup policy
tasks.intent: Apply the settled protection and backup attributes to each existing M1 store and temporary-file location.
acceptance: Record and test per-store attributes and before/after-first-unlock expectations using the F01 contract; do not claim a simulator proves physical lock behavior.
A simulator integration persists via the real core in protected locations, verifies backup exclusions, and leaves data intact on a protection/setup failure.

tasks.title: Enforce authenticated private-read sessions
tasks.intent: Gate private reads, relock transitions and app-switcher presentation using the native authentication session.
acceptance: Denied/cancelled authentication and foreground/relock invalidate access without deleting source; capture permission alone cannot read history.
A real-core simulator integration proves private reads are denied before authentication and after relock; redact the app switcher and link physical checks to the existing device evidence task.

tasks.title: Implement transactional foreground ingress import
tasks.intent: Import a foreground ingress record using existing capture storage inside a single durable, idempotent core transaction.
acceptance: Identical ingress retries converge; conflicting ID reuse, malformed metadata and partial input fail without acknowledged source loss.

Inject failures before and after commit and reopen the database; return explicit committed/not-committed status and never delete an uncommitted sole source. Create the projection and text index within the same import transaction using D04/R01 APIs.

tasks.title: Connect protected native ingress to durable core import
tasks.intent: Connect native text/audio ownership to the core importer and acknowledge only after the durable boundary.
acceptance: Real-core simulator tests cover process interruption, repeated handoff and cleanup only after import confirmation; audio references remain protected and valid.
Use one foreground app writer. Recovery exposes recoverable input or honest failure and never creates an extension writer, duplicate item or false saved acknowledgment.

tasks.title: Allocate bounded native-notification capacity
tasks.intent: Allocate the verified OS pending-request budget to explicit reminders before optional prompts using the documented horizon/refill rule.
acceptance: Below/at/above-limit tests return every overflow as explicit unscheduled work; nothing is silently dropped or falsely installed.
Desired-state reconciliation preserves stable IDs and priority on retries/refill; elapsed time never becomes delivery evidence.

tasks.title: Reconcile notification authorization and delivery uncertainty
tasks.intent: Feed native authorization/revocation changes into the existing capacity/reconciliation/status contracts.
acceptance: Revocation, denial and foreground refresh report usable unscheduled/undeliverable state without treating Focus or clock passage as delivery/attention.
Real-core simulator tests verify permission changes and capacity interactions with explicit reminders and optional prompts, without duplicate effects.

tasks.title: Implement the core job dispatch loop
tasks.intent: Drain existing leased jobs through injected capabilities with bounded work and the established configuration/version guards.
acceptance: Fake-clock tests cover lease recovery, retry limits, cancellation/checkpoint and duplicate results against real job/apply operations.
A result received after a reminder opportunity preserves source and honest unscheduled state; the runner never invents a replacement deadline or destination.

tasks.title: Drive the job loop from native lifecycle events
tasks.intent: Register launch, foreground, reachability and suspension hooks that drive the existing core loop without blocking capture.
acceptance: Repeated/overlapping activation cannot start duplicate drainers; suspend/terminate cancels or checkpoints through the core contract.
Real-core simulator tests resume durable pending jobs after restart/network return. Expose the capability registration seam for C05; do not claim transcription works before its handler is supplied.

tasks.title: Implement bounded native recording sessions
tasks.intent: Implement explicit user-started recording, protected incremental source persistence and bounded stop/cancel/interruption handling.
acceptance: Denied microphone, audio interruption, lock and duration/size limit produce recoverable saved audio or an honest failure; there is no always-listening or network recording path.
Simulator tests inject recorder failures and verify file ownership/acknowledgment; platform-only lock/termination behavior remains in the physical matrix.

tasks.title: Present recoverable voice captures on re-entry
tasks.intent: Add the source-preserving recovery controls and presentation around the recording state machine.
acceptance: Restart discovers partial/saved recordings and offers bounded continue/finish/delete behavior without a mandatory cleanup queue; cancellation does not silently erase acknowledged source.
Tests cover re-entry after interruption and user cancellation, keeping duration/size/error messages honest and normal capture immediately usable.

tasks.title: Implement guarded core transcript attachment
tasks.intent: Apply native transcription outcomes to durable audio captures in Rust; keep revision, lifecycle, reset-generation and routing authority in the core.
acceptance: Apply a successful transcript with provenance, original-audio identity and successful-transcription time in one retry-safe transaction; use existing event/projection/job APIs and enqueue interpretation only when authorized. Failure or abstention retains the sole source and explicit pending state.

Late results after correction, deletion or reset cannot replace authoritative content; crash/retry cannot duplicate attachment or work. Tests distinguish saved audio, transcript completion and interpretation completion.
ownership_allowances: core/src/domain/items/ (transcript event type, TextState::Transcribed and its StateTransition; granted 2026-10-10 after PR #150 round 2; one PR, ordered before C05b)
core/src/store/schema/ and core/tests/migrations/ (schema v7: transcript provenance table keyed by item and source job; same grant)
core/src/lifecycle/delete_intent/ (redact transcript event text and delete provenance rows on deletion, with test; same grant)

tasks.title: Connect offline transcription to queued core attachment
tasks.intent: Implement the proven on-device recognizer and register it with the runner, handing every outcome to the guarded core transcript operation.
acceptance: A queued durable recording executes the real native handler and applies its result through C05a; interruption/retry/cancellation converge. Available on-device models produce text offline; unsupported or missing models stay pending and never fall back to a remote service.

Exact-revision real-core simulator integration covers handler registration, bounded result/error transport, stale results and preservation of source. Report actual offline recognition device evidence separately when the simulator cannot establish it; do not fabricate certification.

tasks.title: Compute source-safe audio retention eligibility
tasks.intent: Determine retention state and cleanup intent using the successful-transcription timestamp and existing authoritative source state.
acceptance: Default expiry is seven days after transcription success; pending/unsupported/failing sole-source recordings do not expire automatically.
Injected-clock cases cover user correction, deletion and absent timestamps. Return visible unresolved/storage-pressure states and explicit retry/delete options without silent loss.

tasks.title: Execute resumable native audio retention cleanup
tasks.intent: Remove only audio approved by the core retention policy and acknowledge effect completion durably.
acceptance: Interruption before/after file removal converges on next sweep; stale retention work cannot remove newly protected or sole-source audio.
Integration tests cover policy decisions against real files and completion state; failure is visible, bounded and never reported as successful cleanup.

tasks.title: Export a consistent scoped core snapshot
tasks.intent: Serialize source, corrections and authoritative state from a consistent read snapshot into the documented portable format.
acceptance: Explicit scope/authentication context excludes deleted/out-of-scope content, credentials and sensitive endpoint configuration; concurrent edits yield one coherent snapshot.
A test-only reader reconstructs equivalent item state and rejects malformed/truncated output; optional audio references are explicit and this is not a restore feature.

tasks.title: Share exports through protected native temporaries
tasks.intent: Connect authenticated export requests and explicit optional audio inclusion to the platform share lifecycle.
acceptance: Share completion, cancellation, interruption and next launch clean protected temporaries without deleting source or reporting success prematurely.
Exercise real-core export in simulator and verify exported contents stay within selected scope, no secrets appear, and unavailable/deleted audio is reported honestly.

tasks.title: Implement opt-in shadow selection and budget accounting
tasks.intent: Select diagnostic cases only when a separately approved review profile/policy and bounded sampling budget allow them.
acceptance: Default-off, revoked/unapproved route and exhausted-budget cases dispatch nothing; reserve/account budget consistently across retries.
Shadow records carry provenance and unreviewed/error outcomes but have no authority to mutate item, reminder or permission state. Test against actual domain guards.

tasks.title: Run authorized shadow diagnostics through native services
tasks.intent: Execute selected review requests using existing native transport/credentials and store bounded diagnostic outcomes through the core contract.
acceptance: Timeout/cancellation records unreviewed; disagreement records diagnostics only, with no extra round or authoritative mutation.
Real-core simulator tests verify route denial, redacted diagnostics and budgeted dispatch; configuration exposes the separate approved profile and instrumentation remains optional.

tasks.title: Build scoped original-text search UI
tasks.intent: Connect literal search, date and session-topic filters to existing scoped retrieval operations.
acceptance: Offline/provider-free search returns original/corrected words with date/type/source and an honest empty state; authenticated scope is enforced before counts/snippets appear.
Session topics since a date work without generated answers or network parsing, and selecting a result passes an opaque validated identifier to detail navigation.

tasks.title: Build authenticated source detail and retained-audio playback
tasks.intent: Show source/correction provenance and offer playback only for retained authorized source audio.
acceptance: Authentication/relock is enforced for text and playback; deleted/expired/unavailable audio has an honest disabled state and no stale file access.
Tests open search results, compare original and corrected text, play synthetic retained audio and handle deletion/expiration without invented quotations.

tasks.title: Add source, type and session-topic correction controls
tasks.intent: Add explicit source/transcript editing, type correction and the independent session-topic toggle using existing revisioned operations.
acceptance: Corrections preserve original provenance and survive relaunch/reprocessing; stale revision conflicts are visible rather than silently overwritten.
Session-topic changes do not change privacy scope, and changing a label never silently converts an idea into an obligation.

tasks.title: Add item completion and suggestion lifecycle controls
tasks.intent: Add completion/cancellation, not-now and stop-suggesting actions using existing domain lifecycle operations.
acceptance: Each action updates actual durable state and handles stale/deleted targets; retries/reprocessing cannot undo the user action.
Explain cooldown and pull-only behavior; stopping suggestions preserves retrieval and does not cancel an explicit reminder unless the domain operation explicitly calls for it.

tasks.title: Add explicit reminder editing UI
tasks.intent: Connect requested/resolved date/time edits and cancellation to existing reminder commands.
acceptance: Show resolved timezone and honest unsupported-repeat, permission, capacity and expired-opportunity states; saving an edit is not falsely presented as OS installation.
Tests prove edits cancel stale requests and retain one desired reminder across retry/restart.

tasks.title: Present reminder history and authenticated navigation
tasks.intent: Display observed installation/cancellation/user events and route generic notification links to the correct protected record.
acceptance: No clock-derived fired/seen/missed fiction appears; acknowledge is distinct from complete and unknown delivery stays unknown.
Tests cover stale/deleted link IDs, failed authentication and re-entry after a lapse without replaying old history as a digest.

tasks.title: Build provider-profile configuration controls
tasks.intent: Add protocol/endpoint/model/capability selection and default-profile changes against the existing versioned profile service.
acceptance: Validation rejects unsupported/incomplete combinations and clearly represents local-only or unreachable private-server operation.
Changing defaults preserves captures and queued-job destination pinning; UI never rewrites old jobs to another vendor implicitly.

tasks.title: Add native credential setup and redacted connection checks
tasks.intent: Connect profile credential references to native secure entry/update/removal and an explicitly authorized connection test.
acceptance: Secret input goes directly to the native credential service, is cleared promptly, and is never rendered back into a webview, persisted UI state or diagnostic output.
Tests cover invalid/removed credentials, network failure and capability mismatch with redacted feedback; no background test uploads private capture text.

tasks.title: Build local-first processing-policy onboarding
tasks.intent: Offer deliberate destination/capability authorization while preserving a functional local-only initial state.
acceptance: Fresh install captures and retrieves before any provider setup; route labels are clear and sticky, with no classifier-created authorization.
Tests show accepting one capability/destination does not authorize another, and cancelling setup leaves local behavior usable.

tasks.title: Add processing-policy change and revocation controls
tasks.intent: Expose existing versioned policy updates and explicit queued-work choices without silently changing destinations.
acceptance: Revoke or change a profile/capability while work is queued or in-flight and display the actual resulting state; late results cannot bypass revocation.
Explicit retry/requeue is inspectable, no-approved-provider state remains usable, and route preferences survive relaunch.

tasks.title: Implement durable core reset generation and fencing
tasks.intent: Persist the global reset boundary in Rust and compose existing per-item deletion/cleanup intents under a durable generation fence.
acceptance: Start/retry reset atomically records its generation and invalidates old in-flight work; every core result/apply path uses the existing fence hook so reset cannot revive captures or issue new effects. Reuse the established schema/transaction and guard interfaces.

Process-restart tests cover populated mixed-route records, jobs and indexes. Reset remains pending until required cleanup acknowledgments arrive; capture after completed reset belongs to a fresh generation.

tasks.title: Orchestrate native reset cleanup and credential choice
tasks.intent: Coordinate native deletion effects and explicit optional credential/profile removal around the durable Rust reset operation.
acceptance: Exercise mixed-route captures, retained audio, ingress, export/share temporaries and native notifications; reuse per-item executors and acknowledge only actual completed cleanup. Required failures remain durably pending and retries after crash cannot restore private content or scheduled reminders.

Real-core simulator integration verifies old callbacks are rejected by the reset fence, optional credential removal follows the explicit choice, and post-completion capture uses a fresh generation. No Swift-owned competing generation or premature reset-success state.

tasks.title: Add retention status and settings UI
tasks.intent: Show and configure the existing source-safe retention policy and unresolved sole-audio cases.
acceptance: Seven-day successful-transcription default, sole-source exception and storage pressure are clear; retry/delete choices use existing operations.
Tests verify real policy/progress/error state and keep new capture available during non-destructive sweeps.

tasks.title: Add authenticated export controls
tasks.intent: Connect scope selection, explicit audio inclusion and export/share feedback to the existing export service.
acceptance: UI reports actual snapshot/share failure or completion, explains external export/backup limits and does not expose secrets or out-of-scope records.
Tests cover cancelled share and cleanup of protected temporaries, with no false full-backup/restore claim.

tasks.title: Add deletion and reset progress controls
tasks.intent: Connect explicit per-item deletion and delete-all/reset choices to the existing durable cleanup services.
acceptance: Deletion remains pending until required effects finish; retry/restart show actual progress/error and never redisplay deleted source.
Tests cover optional credential reset and clearly explain backup/export limits without promising recall of external copies; capture resumes under the new reset generation.

tasks.title: Build bounded optional-prompt settings
tasks.intent: Expose opt-in, selected local time, bounded horizon/cooldown and disable controls for the existing prompt service.
acceptance: Default is off; configuration and cancellation persist and never disable explicit reminders.
Explain horizon/refill behavior and test permission/capacity failure without a catch-up burst or disclosure of private content.

tasks.title: Build authenticated suggestion response UI
tasks.intent: Present the current eligible suggestion and route not-now/stop/done through existing revisioned operations.
acceptance: Authenticate before private content; stale/completed/deleted suggestions are resolved again and an empty set is calm.
Tests verify actual stored policy/lifecycle changes and relaunch persistence without inbox cleanup or accidental changes to explicit reminders.

tasks.title: Verify capture durability under process failure
tasks.intent: Build a process-level durability harness around actual capture/ingress persistence.
acceptance: Kill/reopen around each durable acknowledgment boundary and prove every acknowledged capture survives with stable identity.
Repeated ingress and partial file handoff produce neither duplicate captures nor deletion of the sole uncommitted source; fixture state is synthetic.

tasks.title: Verify processing retry and deletion-race safety
tasks.intent: Inject provider/configuration/application failures through existing runner and guard integration paths.
acceptance: Timeout, invalid output and changed policy preserve source/permission boundaries; crash/retry cannot duplicate an authoritative mutation.
A deletion or explicit correction racing a provider result cannot resurrect or overwrite source; tests invoke real integration paths rather than copied algorithms.

tasks.title: Verify outbound destination and credential isolation
tasks.intent: Exercise base-provider authorization, transport and queued/in-flight configuration handling using synthetic canaries.
acceptance: Unapproved capability/destination, redirect and stale/revoked profile tests emit no unauthorized canary or credential; approved remote processing is accurately identified.
No secret/content leaks into transport logs. This suite excludes optional Spark/shadow/preview requirements; their owners retain dedicated canaries.

tasks.title: Verify private reads, notifications and export isolation
tasks.intent: Exercise local authenticated reads and outward presentations using mixed-scope synthetic records.
acceptance: Queries, counts/snippets, private source detail, generic notification payloads and exports cannot reveal out-of-scope or locked content.
Deleted/relocked records and cancelled exports leave no readable application temporaries; test log redaction and preserve the separate optional-capability canaries.

tasks.title: Exercise provider and permission failure journeys
tasks.intent: Drive the real app through provider outage and denied/revoked permission cases with deterministic boundary fakes.
acceptance: Saved source remains retrievable, retry is source-preserving, and capture remains available without mandatory triage.
Assert independently honest save/processing/scheduling state through UI plus persisted state, including failed notification permission.

tasks.title: Exercise restart, transcription and deletion failure journeys
tasks.intent: Drive interruption, expired background execution, restart and deletion-during-processing through production app wiring.
acceptance: Acknowledged audio/text survive interrupted transcription and restart; late jobs do not restore deleted items or stale notification effects.
Recovery avoids a cleanup gate and keeps all status dimensions honest; test actual native/core composition with synthetic source and deterministic effects.

tasks.title: Verify the Spark serving protocol from the worker context
tasks.intent: Build a fail-closed, tested probe that inspects the user-controlled endpoint with authorized synthetic requests from the Odonian worker, and record only values the probe actually observed.
acceptance: The probe fails closed: unauthenticated success is reported as authentication-not-required, TLS is reported only when verified against the default trust store, OpenAI-compatible classification requires a parsed body with the expected structure, the structured-response probe requires JSON content matching the requested shape, any failed probe exits non-zero, provider key is explicit, empty base URL or credential is an explicit error, and chat probes use a model the endpoint listed.

Focused stub-server tests cover each classification, failure paths, exit codes and the sanitization guarantee that neither endpoint address nor credential appears in stdout, stderr or the sanitized artifact; the tests run under make test or a documented CI-executed Python test command.

The probe was run as submitted from the worker and its named sanitized evidence artifact is committed under docs/validation/evidence/spark-probe/ with evidence id, probe revision and dirty flag, collection time, per-request method/path/credential-sent/status, allowlisted headers, endpoint-returned model identifiers and structured-response result; address and credential are never written.

docs/validation/spark-protocol.md contains only observed values citing evidence id, revision and time, a matrix derived from the endpoint /models response, and an explicit statement that phone-context reachability is unverified and owned by V08b.

tasks.title: Record phone-context reachability of the Spark endpoint
tasks.intent: Fold the maintainer-collected iPhone-over-Tailscale evidence into the protocol document and set the final verified status.
acceptance: docs/validation/spark-protocol.md gains a phone-context section whose every value cites the maintainer's named artifact, collection time and network context (Wi-Fi or cellular, Tailscale connected) for unauthenticated and authenticated requests, including HTTP status, scheme and certificate outcome.

Overall status becomes verified only if the V08a artifact and the phone-context artifact both exist and agree on protocol and authentication behavior; any disagreement is recorded as the exact verified compatibility boundary for V09.

tasks.title: Build and test the signing and device-build tooling
tasks.intent: Make the signing automation correct and provably safe on Linux with stubbed Apple tools, so that a maintainer can run it unchanged on a Mac.
acceptance: Unsigned simulator path stays credential-free; signing inputs only from environment or injected files; no secret, raw device identifier or profile content reaches stdout, logs or evidence.

Each route uses the correct identity class and, where required, archive/export with an explicit export options file; profile referenced by name or UUID; failed or device-less install exits non-zero; per-run temporary keychains cleaned on every exit path.
Behaviour tests against stub security/xcodebuild/devicectl assert exit codes, messages, cleanup, redaction and evidence schema; wired into make test; no vacuous assertions.
signing.md documents the P08b maintainer procedure and makes no unobserved validity claim.

tasks.title: Record the signed build and device-install evidence
tasks.intent: Fold the maintainer-produced signed-build and device-install evidence into the signing document and state the verified install validity for the trial.
acceptance: signing.md cites the maintainer's named artifact with build revision, collection time, content-free build and device identifiers and the observed profile expiry.
Install validity for the two-week trial derives from the observed profile expiry; the renewal plan is tested and recorded or explicitly marked untested.

tasks.title: Move native CI to macOS 26 and Xcode 26.6
tasks.intent: Replace the unexplained Xcode 16.4 pin with the newest toolchain on GitHub-hosted runners so that simulator evidence and device signing use the same SDK generation as the trial iPhone.
acceptance: Both ios.yml jobs run on macos-26 with Xcode 26.6; simulator ceiling follows the selected SDK; config check enforces workflow pin equals options.xcodeVersion.

Exact-head ios.yml run green on the submitted commit: OhAndTests, every probe build, launch smoke, Tauri round-trip; out-of-scope iOS 26 breakage recorded and blocked rather than fixed outside owned paths.
AGENTS.md names the new runner, Xcode and SDK with evidence requirements unchanged.

tasks.title: Extend reminder-withdrawal grammar coverage
tasks.intent: Add withdrawal phrasings and over-rejection fixes outside the bounded I05 grammar, driven by a synthetic fixture corpus.
acceptance: Fixture corpus under core/tests/proposal_application/ drives the withdrawal/control behavior test; every I05 construction carried over unchanged.
Known over-rejections schedule again: 'about <verb>-ing' task objects, coordinated verbs inside the requested task, 'need to <verb>' complements.
Withdrawals produce no reminder rows/operations with source and non-reminder facets intact; controls produce exactly one scheduled reminder.

addenda.change: Split V08 into V08a (worker-side probe) and V08b (maintainer phone-context evidence over Tailscale); V09 now depends on V08b. Original task 939fe62e-5074-45e5-ad67-156834129c13 retired after two rejected review rounds on PR #60.

B01b ordered ownership allowance for ios/project.yml (named settings), core/bindings/build-ios.sh lock, core-binding.md section and ios/Tests/CoreBridge/; B01b now depends on P07 to serialize ios/project.yml edits.

Split P08 into P08a (Linux-testable signing tooling) and P08b (maintainer signed-build and device-install evidence); P09, T05 and T10 now depend on P08b. Original task 7d4836ee-0236-4f17-9f21-bc3ec1d3d7e0 retired after two rejected review rounds on PR #27.
Added F08: move native CI to macos-26 and Xcode 26.6 (the 16.4 pin cannot install on the iOS 26.6.2 trial iPhone). F08 depends on P07; B01b and P08a depend on F08.

B01c: ownership allowance for ios/Tests/CoreBridge/CaptureStatusTests.swift and a recorded decision that ohand_core_start_save_capture is a pre-import capture write; C02a owns route validation and the ingestion acknowledgment.
Bounded the withdrawal grammar I05 criterion 2 requires (PR #96 breaker after four rounds); added I05b for phrasings and over-rejections outside that list, depending on I05.

Standing native-boundary allowance: a task whose acceptance needs an unexported core operation may add one task-named module under core/src/ffi/ (+ pub mod line) and one extension file under ios/OhAndCoreBridge/. V05b may also give OhAndServices the core search-path/link settings once. Real-core simulator tests may seed routes/profiles/jobs by SQL until U05 exposes creation.
B02 also depends on N02: its composition test must observe a scheduler request through the real native notification bridge, which did not exist when B02 was claimed.

P09 scope amendment, recorded by the coordinator on 2026-10-09 at the maintainer's direction: hardware keyboard navigation of the Tauri probe (docs/validation/tauri-handoff.md device procedure step 4) is deferred out of P09 to U10, which already owns keyboard and accessibility navigation of the real management UI with a documented actual-device pass. Reason: the maintainer has no Bluetooth or Smart Keyboard for the trial phone, and the probe is a feasibility shell, not the UI that ships. The checks that were run are recorded in docs/validation/evidence/device-feasibility/2026-10-09-device-matrix.json and 2026-10-10-latency-accessibility.json; each record lists its own not-tested and not-observable items, which remain unmet P09 checks unless a later amendment defers them. P09's acceptance is otherwise unchanged; it is graded against its own pinned criteria in docs/features/m1-plan.md#p09, not against docs/validation/m1-protocol.md, which is T08's two-week trial rubric.

C05a ownership allowance for transcript provenance: a transcript event type and TextState::Transcribed in core/src/domain/items/, schema v7 transcript provenance table with migration tests, and deletion redaction in core/src/lifecycle/delete_intent/. Granted after PR #150 showed criterion 1 cannot be met inside the owned paths without projecting machine text as a user correction or discarding the audio identity.
